title: dronuradaras.lt acoustic sensor status
description: Published BY bridges/vendors/mainline/dronuradaras_bridge.py to '{TOPIC_ROOT}/land/mainline_dronuradaras/acoustic/neutral/sensor/{sensor_id}/tracks/v1' — one record per registered acoustic sensor, republished on every device poll (online/offline) and again with a fresh last_detection_ts whenever that sensor reports a detection (recolors its own marker rather than spawning a separate icon).

last_detection_ts.description: Present only on a detection-refresh publish (_publish_sensor_alert), never on a plain online/offline device-poll publish.

last_detection_audio_url.description: Present only when the detection carried an audio clip URL.

_delete.description: Present only on the offline-tombstone variant (a device that disappeared from the registry while still marked online).
